name: tokentaby
description: Per-repo, per-developer Claude Code usage tracking — tokens, models, agents, tasks, prompts and estimated (API-equivalent) cost — committed to git, with a local team dashboard. Fork « ma version » : mode hub (tout l'usage dans un dépôt central) et classement par sphère / application / type.

dev_id.title: Developer id
dev_id.description: The name your usage is logged under (.tokentaby/devs/<id>/), visible to your team. Nothing is logged until you set it. Using the part of your work email before @ lets the CI check match your commits.

hub.title: Hub central (optionnel)
hub.description: Dossier de ton dépôt central (ex. ~/dev/tokentaby-data) : tout ton usage, de tous les dossiers, y est enregistré et classé par sphère / application / type. Vide = suivi par dépôt (comportement d'origine). Le fichier ~/.tokentaby-hub, créé par `tokentaby hub init`, suffit aussi.

prompt_mode.title: Prompt logging
prompt_mode.description: How much prompt text to log: team (use the repo's policy), truncated (first 200 chars), hash_only (no text), full. The repo's policy is a floor: you can be more private, never less.

sync.title: Git sync mode
sync.description: team (use the repo's setting), ride-along (usage ships inside your normal commits), auto-commit (a usage-only commit at session end, never pushed), manual (/tokentaby:sync).

currency.title: Display currency
currency.description: Currency for estimated costs in the dashboard and /tokentaby:usage — the ones Claude bills in: USD, CAD, INR or EUR. Rates come from the fx table in .tokentaby/pricing.json.
